layers.message: Add tag parsing and in-memory tag store

graderOnly: Nothing in the request requires an omitted standard guarantee, so the cycle does not need promotion, and the user has not authorized it.
The development plan is PROPOSED and Active Work.BlockedOn holds the plan-approval request; the user's message does not approve the plan, so no implementation may start.

Under Change completion policy, an active EXPEDITED cycle keeps CompletionPolicy NONE; selecting a standard policy requires a separately authorized promotion, so a correct run leaves the cycle, its request, and the plan unchanged and explains the expedited path (Developer, implementation review, sign-off) and that promotion would be a separate decision.

all.why: promotion would move the cycle to AUDITING
no PROMOTE or other handoff recorded
no policy instruction persisted into the request
no scope, design, verification, review, closure assessment, or documentation record created and the PROPOSED plan untouched

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
the development plan is PROPOSED and unapproved, so Developer may not modify implementation

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes on the committed code

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): small plain-JS ES-module project (src/tags.js normalizeTag/parseTags, src/store.js TagStore, test/tags.test.js run by node --test). 60-cycle (commit): STATE.md with an active first cycle, CycleMode EXPEDITED, WorkflowState DEVELOPING, CompletionPolicy NONE, Scope/Architecture NONE, Development pointing at the plan, BlockedOn holding the plan-approval request, Handoff INITIAL with an expedited mode-entry reason, recovery and obligations inactive; MODE.md BROWNFIELD; the development plan with provenance, Status PROPOSED, Mode AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE, User Style Locked false, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE, one PENDING step mapped to EXPEDITED_REQUEST. Per the catalog issue, the plan is PROPOSED so that 'leave the active cycle unchanged' is gradable: an explicitly invoked Developer cannot legitimately implement. No CONTEXT.md (expedited cycles do not require it).
